ResearchTabDef.label: Batshit Technology
ResearchTabDef.generalDescription: Devices nobody can fully explain and nobody should probably build. Research them at a research bench like anything else.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Batshittium Lore
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn the basics of batshittium, an element that should not exist. A transmogrifier can coax it out of ordinary rock chunks, ten to one.\n\nUnlocks the Batshittium Transmogrifier, the Batshittium Reactor (250,000 W while a unit burns, for anywhere from minutes to a day and a half, with enough waste heat to cook nearby rooms) and the Random Replicator, which conjures a random meal or raw food every six hours into a refrigerated compartment.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Batshittium Arcana
ResearchProjectDef.description: Delve past the lore into the arcana of batshittium: the deeper, less advisable applications of an element that should not exist.
